description: 1. Agent reads the 220-line MEMORY.md and classifies all sections. 2. Agent creates memory/protocols.md with the three stable workflows (MLS upload, offer submission, weekly digest) including copy-pasteable commands, no project state, ≤100 lines. 3. Agent creates memory/active.md with the three active deals (Riverside, Oakmont, Sunridge) plus a mandatory 'Waiting On' section at the bottom listing Hal Petrov, Donna Hargrove, Priya Nair, ≤80 lines. 4. Agent creates memory/archive.md with completed deals (Elmwood, Harbor View, Pinebrook), people/org directories as tables, account/system info, and historical decision log entries. 5. Agent creates memory/ontology/graph.jsonl with JSONL entries: 'create' ops for each person (p_ prefix), organization (grp_/org_ prefix), project (proj_ prefix), and property (prop_/loc_ prefix), plus 'relate' ops using only the valid relation vocabulary (member_of, owns, collaborates_on, interested_in, guides, uses, listed_by, located_at), all with timestamp fields. 6. Agent rewrites MEMORY.md as a ≤30-line router that preserves the NO_REPLY and HEARTBEAT directives, lists the three tier files with descriptions, notes the ontology location, and contains zero project-specific content like addresses, prices, or external emails.
